# `admin.user.create`

Create a user account

Site admins only. First admin comes from rukie bootstrap instead.

- Method and path: `POST /admin/users`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie admin user create`
- MCP: `admin_user_create`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `email` | body | no | `string` |
| `full_name` | body | no | `string` |
| `is_admin` | body | no | `boolean` |
| `name` | body | yes | `string` |
| `password` | body | no | `string` |
| `random` | body | no | `boolean` |

## Errors

`conflict`, `forbidden`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
